model.name: Governance: no auto-minting of new sprints (Tron authorizes sprints)
model.description: GOVERNANCE (TRON RULE, from S30 on): NO agent auto-mints a new Sprint unit. Only Tron authorizes a new sprint (Tron tells the planner). New requirements are placed in an EXISTING sprint's backlog (e.g. S28/S29), never a freshly-minted sprint, unless Tron explicitly authorizes it. S1-S29 are grandfathered (already minted, incl S28/S29 which robbin-req auto-minted this session - the behavior this rule stops). A by-construction guard (planner + trace:audit) flags any NEW ior:class:Sprint unit created without a Tron-authorization record - delta-scoped so the grandfathered sprints do not false-red.

acceptanceCriteria.text: From S30 on, NO agent auto-mints a new ior:class:Sprint unit; only Tron authorizes a new sprint (Tron -> planner). New requirements go into an EXISTING sprint's backlog unless Tron authorizes a new sprint.

A new Sprint unit created under Tron authorization carries a Tron-authorization record (authorizedBy: Tron, ref: <directive>, at: <ts>). This is a TIER-2 audit-anchor (agent-transcribed, UNSIGNED) - it proves intent + gives an audit trail, but is not cryptographically fail-closed (Tron chose TIER-2 2026-07-02).

A guard (planner mint-choke + trace:audit) HARD-FLAGS any NEW Sprint unit (number >= 30) minted WITHOUT a Tron-authorization record - blocking SILENT/ACCIDENTAL auto-minting (the recurring behavior). It does NOT block a MALICIOUS/forged mint: the authorization record is TIER-2 (agent-transcribed, unsigned - a lying agent could fabricate {authorizedBy:Tron}); #17-no-fabricate is the backstop for that case, NOT this guard. DELTA-scoped so grandfathered S1-S29 do NOT false-red.
New requirements captured without a new sprint resolve to an existing sprint's backlog (parent -> an existing Sprint unit), and the traceability holds.

Attempting to mint S30+ WITHOUT an auth record -> flagged (silent/accidental blocked); a Tron-authorized mint WITH the record -> allowed; existing S1-29 -> not flagged. KNOWN LIMIT: a forged record passes the guard (TIER-2) - covered by #17-no-fabricate, not this gate.

model.crossRefNote: By-construction guard is a trace:audit gate sibling to R27.5's chain-gate (marker-has-chain) - the audit host, delta-scoped like R27.2 INV2. R24.5 = trace:audit:strict. Distinct check (sprint-mint-authorization, not marker-has-chain) -> its own req, not folded.
